# question-1

## question-1

### A. What it does

- The measure would fund the county library system with a levy of 0.5 mills. `T1` [s1](../sources/question-1/_race/text.md)
  > The measure would fund the county library system with a levy of 0.5 mills.

### B. Fiscal effect

- The levy would raise about $1.2 million a year, the county fiscal office estimates. `T1` [s1](../sources/question-1/_race/text.md)
  > The levy would raise about $1.2 million a year, the county fiscal office estimates.

### C. Arguments for

- Says: The library levy keeps every branch open. `T1s` [s1](../sources/question-1/_race/arguments.md)
  > The library levy keeps every branch open.

### D. Arguments against

- Says: The levy raises taxes on every household. `T1s` [s1](../sources/question-1/_race/arguments.md)
  > The levy raises taxes on every household.
